'''Sorelana Alsahhan''' was a scholar during the [[Trolloc Wars]] who wrote of "The hundred packs the Shadow's hounds that hunt the night". [[Masuri]] cites this as she tells [[Perrin]] and the others of the [[Darkhounds]] that had passed outside his camp.
